powers.name: Touch of Evil
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, sicken a creature for rounds equal to half cleric level. While sickened this way, it counts as good for spells with the evil descriptor. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Scythe of Evil
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the unholy special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 fire damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Fire Resistance
powers.summary: Gain fire resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.

powers.name: Touch of Good
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature to grant a sacred bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Holy Lance
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the holy special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Rebuke Death
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a living creature below 0 hit points to heal 1d4 damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Healer's Blessing
powers.summary: Treat cure spells as empowered, increasing the damage healed by 50%. This does not increase damage dealt to undead or stack with Empower Spell.

powers.name: Lore Keeper
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, gain information about a creature as though making the appropriate Knowledge check with a result equal to 15 + cleric level + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Remote Viewing
powers.summary: Use clairvoyance/clairaudience at will as a spell-like ability for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.
